query:
SELECT s.id as student_id, en.class_id
                FROM guardians g
                JOIN students s ON s.guardian_id = g.id
                LEFT JOIN enrollments en ON en.student_id = s.id AND (en.status = 'Active' OR en.status = 'ACTIVE')
                WHERE g.user_id = $1 AND g.tenant_id = $2
                LIMIT 1
